title: Equivalence of flat connections and Fay identities on arbitrary Riemann surfaces
summary: A flat connection on a Riemann surface with values in an infinite dimensional Lie algebra provides a systematic and effective tool for generating an infinite family of polylogarithms via iterated integrals. The recent literature offers different types of connections, in one or several variables, on compact Riemann surfaces with or without punctures, and in the meromorphic or single-valued categories.
